en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Abu Umeyr, from Bakkar Bin Kardam, and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The delight of my eyes is in the Salat (Prayer) and the pleasure in the women’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Bakkar ibn Kardam from more than one person who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
The delight for my eyes is placed in Salat (prayer) and my pleasure in women.’”
